'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Kyle Krueger LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Username:''' Meto
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
